title: The Dynific Addons for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the 'q'… (CVE-2026-103914)
description: The Dynific Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin up to version 1.3 is vulnerable to an SQL Injection via the 'q' parameter. This flaw arises from improper escaping of user input in the ae_preview_post() AJAX handler and its preview_post_filter() callback, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access or higher to inject SQL code. The vulnerability enables attackers to extract sensitive database information. The CVSS score is 6.5, indicating a medium severity risk.
